scope: Read-only course/material discovery for the student's enrolled catalogue. No application/backend implementation or source-system writes.
authentication: User-supplied Firebase ID token used transiently in Authorization header. Token not stored in project files.
hierarchy: Course -> module -> lesson/chapter (returned by sections endpoint) -> component -> file/link or folder files

files.accessUrls: Download URLs contain access tokens. Preserve privately when importing; never publish their raw query strings. Do not attach the API bearer to the storage request.

pdfInspection.title: Chapter 1 Introduction to ML
pdfInspection.conclusion: This sample supports page-level text extraction without OCR. Other documents still need inspection.

importImplications: Use structured API reads rather than DOM scraping.
Preserve stable source ids, source ordering, original titles, academic metadata and learning outcomes.
Support folder attachments, datasets and links alongside PDFs.
Keep import work separate from university account progress or submissions.

downloadSnapshot.verification: All 35 originals and Windows copies match recorded SHA-256 hashes.
downloadSnapshot.firebaseAccess: Full supplied download URLs work without bearer authentication. Removing the query download token from the tested PDF returned HTTP 403.
